title: Mounted Stantler keeps a skid through a two-key turn, then crashes at the blocked tile

verification.actor: One current mounted Stantler (species 234, party slot 0) on map 33
verification.trigger: From map 33 (583,406), hold Right until the current mounted Stantler first targets (588,406) in a completed frame (at most 32 frames). Then hold Down and Left together for 18 frames. The pending Right Walk must commit before the due skid request.
verification.observable: One complete West-facing east skid moves from (588,406) to clear (589,406) and commits once. Blocked (590,406) then causes Crash and clears momentum at (589,406). After that exact idle boundary, the still-held chord starts one native-admitted ordinary West Walk toward (588,406). No skid crosses the wall or is canceled.

setupMutations.change: Copy test.nds and test.sav. Teleport to map 33 (583,406), prepare party slot 0 level-10 Stantler, mount, settle 16 neutral frames, and bind its live actor. Do not edit profile, policy, motion, facing, input, or terrain during observation.

limits: Prepared placement does not prove natural travel or acquisition. Right, Down, and Left use normal keys and unchanged Sprint timing.
This case measures one clear skid before the blocked next tile during a two-key turn. It does not prove every terrain obstacle.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked test must pass on the current ROM.

events.value: Prepare and bind one mounted Stantler at map 33 (583,406).
Hold Right until the current Stantler first targets (588,406), within 32 completed frames; leave that Walk in flight.
Hold Down and Left together for 18 completed frames through one West-facing east skid and the blocked next-tile Crash.

stop.condition: One clear West-facing east skid commit, then blocked next-tile Crash with idle control at (589,406), then one native-admitted ordinary West Walk from still-held input.

invariants: The bound mounted Stantler and rider stay at or before the last clear tile (589,406) in every completed frame.
The due east skid starts with West facing from the two held directions, despite the blocked Down tile.
No skid motion starts toward blocked (590,406).
Only the clear skid tile commits before Crash.
No motion is canceled while the due skid resolves.
Crash first returns idle mounted input ownership with zero speed and pending motion at (589,406). Only afterward can the held chord start one ordinary West Walk away from the wall.
